splash_subtitle: Let's configure your server in just a few steps
splash_settings_note: You can change all of these settings later in the admin settings.
step_donation_subtitle: This is the only time we'll ask: if you find this app useful, please consider supporting its development with a donation. Your contribution helps us maintain and improve the project.
btn_support_info_aria: Support information (opens in a new tab)
donation_note: Thank you for considering a donation. You can skip this step if you prefer.
step_appname_subtitle: Choose a name that will be displayed throughout the application
step_url_subtitle: Add every browser origin that may access this application.
url_hint: The first URL is primary and is used for generated links and callbacks.
current_origin_warning_message: You are currently accessing Omlorix through {currentOrigin}. After setup, browser requests from this address will be blocked because it is not in the configured public URL list.
step_branding_subtitle: Drop in your logos and favicon so the product feels yours from day one.
icon_hint: SVG recommended for best quality. Other image formats are also supported.
step_role_subtitle: Decide which role is automatically assigned to every new account.
role_hint: The selected role will be used for every newly created account until you change it in the admin settings.
complete_subtitle: Your server has been configured successfully
error_application_name_required: Enter an application name to continue.
error_public_url_required: Add at least one public URL to continue.
error_public_url_invalid: Public URL {position} must be a full HTTP or HTTPS URL.
error_public_url_duplicate: Each public URL must be unique.
error_brand_assets_required: Upload at least one logo to continue.
error_logo_upload_failed: Failed to upload logo. Please try again.
error_icon_upload_failed: Failed to upload icon. Please try again.
error_complete_setup_failed: Failed to complete server setup. Please try again.
error_complete_setup_unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error_brand_asset_image_types: {label} must be a PNG, JPEG, or WEBP image.
error_brand_asset_image_types_svg: {label} must be a PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or SVG image.
